summary: Veraxa Biotech AG filed a Form 6-K on July 10, 2026, announcing the appointment of Carl von Halem as Interim Chief Financial Officer, succeeding Torsten Bürgermeister. The change is effective immediately, with Mr. von Halem serving until a permanent successor is identified. The filing highlights Mr. von Halem's experience as CFO of Xlife Sciences AG and his familiarity with Veraxa's public listing process. No other financial terms, board recommendations, or deal mechanics are disclosed. This is a non-US foreign private issuer report mapping to a US current report on Form 8-K Item 5.02. Watch for further updates on permanent CFO appointment.
